subject: Rescheduling our call
text: Hi, After the two-day gap since our first check-in, I am writing to reschedule the call that slipped yesterday. I understand schedules have been unstable, but we need a short session before the project summary is finalized. I looked at shared calendars and found Thursday at 10:30 as the cleanest open slot. If you accept, I will send a fresh invitation with a short agenda covering vendor changes, outstanding risks, and the next milestones. If you need to add another colleague, let me know who should be included, because I can extend the meeting only once without breaking a prior commitment. Please confirm whether that works by the end of today, because I need to hold the room and block focus time. If Thursday does not suit you, the next practical option is Friday at 9:00. I would strongly prefer to avoid the following week, since the review deck is due Friday afternoon and we will need notes before then. You can reply with a quick yes, a better time, or a request to move the discussion to written comments instead. Please also flag any agenda item that can be handled asynchronously; I would rather cut the call to twenty minutes than turn it into another status update. Before we meet, could someone update the risk log with the latest client dates? That will save us from spending the call verifying information we can confirm separately. I will circulate a three-line recap immediately after we finish, so the project manager can adjust priorities while the decisions are still fresh. Thanks,
